description: Terminal-Bench style policy repair: bring a drifted logrotate.conf in line with the documented retention policy - weekly rotation, keep 4 compressed, create 0640 app app, su directive, and the reload command from the spec instead of the raw kill.

criteria: The conf matches the retention policy exactly - weekly (not daily), rotate 4, compress, create 0640 app app, su app app, dateext, and the postrotate runs /usr/local/bin/app-reload - with the spec, gate and the existing log untouched.
